title: 13 被震撼的，吴羽策
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

上一场比赛越云打玄奇，狂剑士阿茜娜正面冲阵，玄奇防线一溃千里，越云赢得毫无悬念。

下一场的对手是虚空，双鬼剑，李轩，吴羽策。

在飞机上的时候周珈蓝一直在看虚空的视频，她其实没什么战术能力，好在虚空的弱点很明显，双鬼剑擅长控制，擅长拖后期，最怕冲脸和高速爆发。

刚好这些都在周珈蓝舒适区内。

唯一的悬念是账号卡劣势。

周珈蓝没有接手“横刀”，越云一直在帮她的“阿茜娜”升级。

这张卡的基础不错，技术点和装备都看得过去，越云也是下了血本，不惜拆了孙翔从前的“横刀”全力武装“阿茜娜”。

可是时间太短，跟虚空倾力打造出的两张全明星账号卡比起来，还是有不小的差距。

最大的问题就是银武，周珈蓝心里有个大概的蓝图，但是细节问题还需要一点点试错，稀有材料也没那么容易收集。

最快最快她的银武也要等打完虚空才能到手。

但是没关系。

“会赢的。”周珈蓝轻声说。

距离飞机落地还有一段时间，她压低帽檐，蜷缩在狭小的位置上，昏昏沉沉地睡着了。

像是回应她的话音，脑海中系统屏幕闪了一下，爆出一小蓬金色的星星。

周珈蓝闭着眼，嘴角勾出一点点笑。

X市，虚空主场。

经理左手捧着保温杯，右手挂着一个毛茸茸的披风，手上还拎了一堆巧克力果冻之类的小零食，手机上还在点奶茶和糖水。

不像战队经理，像个伺候公主的老太监。

这些都是给周珈蓝准备的，台上射灯已经亮起，光屏上双方账号卡角色一一显现出来，逢山鬼泣和鬼刻两个全明星角色挨在一起，台下传来大声的欢呼。

经理紧张地擦额头上的冷汗，反过来好声好气叮嘱周珈蓝，“别紧张，打成什么样都无所谓。”

又转身一一叮嘱队员，“听你们队长的安排啊，千万别擅作主张。”

他担心周珈蓝初来乍到，年纪小性格又腼腆，队员或许有不服她的，那麻烦就大了。

其实完全是多虑，越云的成员都不是多么有个性的人，面对周珈蓝这样横空出世的天才，他们是实打实地佩服。

更别说还有路径依赖——只要像上赛季围绕孙翔那样围绕周珈蓝，这赛季越云就能继续维持辉煌。

何乐而不为？没有不听话的理由。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the last game, Yueyun defeated Xuanqi. The mad swordsman Athena charged head-on. Xuanqi's defense line collapsed thousands of miles away. Yueyun won without any suspense.

The next opponents are Void, Double Ghost Sword, Li Xuan, and Wu Yuce.

Zhou Jialan had been watching Void's videos while on the plane. She actually had no tactical ability. Fortunately, Void's weaknesses were obvious. The Double Ghost Sword was good at controlling and delaying the late game. She was most afraid of punching in the face and high-speed explosions.

These happen to be within Zhou Jialan's comfort zone.

The only suspense is the disadvantage of the account card.

Zhou Jialan did not take over "Hengdao", Yue Yun has been helping her "Athena" upgrade.

The basics of this card are good, and the technical points and equipment are passable. Yue Yun also spent a lot of money and did not hesitate to dismantle Sun Xiang's former "Hengdao" and fully arm "Athena".

However, the time was too short, and compared with the two All-Star account cards that Void had worked hard to create, there was still a big gap.

The biggest problem is the silver weapon. Zhou Jialan has a rough blueprint in mind, but the details still require a little trial and error, and rare materials are not that easy to collect.

The fastest and fastest silver weapon she can get is after defeating the Void.

But it doesn't matter.

"We will win." Zhou Jialan said softly.

There was still some time before the plane landed. She lowered the brim of her hat, curled up in a small position, and fell asleep.

As if in response to her words, the system screen in his mind flashed, and a small puff of golden stars burst out.

Zhou Jialan closed his eyes and smiled a little at the corner of his mouth.

City X, the home of Void.

The manager held a thermos cup in his left hand and a furry cloak hanging in his right hand. He also carried a bunch of snacks such as chocolate jelly and ordered milk tea and sugar water on his mobile phone.

Not like a team manager, but like an old eunuch serving a princess.

These are all prepared for Zhou Jialan. The spotlights on the stage have been turned on, and the account card characters of both parties are displayed one by one on the light screen. The two all-star characters of Devil May Cry and Gui Ke are next to each other, and loud cheers can be heard from the audience.

The manager nervously wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and told Zhou Jialan angrily, "Don't be nervous, it doesn't matter what the beating is."

Then he turned around and told the team members one by one, "Listen to your captain's arrangements, and don't make any arbitrary decisions."

He was worried that Zhou Jialan had just arrived, she was young and shy, and some of the team members might be dissatisfied with her, which would cause big trouble.

In fact, it was all over-worry. The members of Yue Yun were not very individual people. Faced with a genius like Zhou Jialan who emerged from nowhere, they truly admired him.

Not to mention there is path dependence - as long as they surround Zhou Jialan like they did around Sun Xiang last season, Yueyun will be able to continue to maintain its glory this season.

Why not?There is no reason to be disobedient.
